definitions.explanation: A specific field, domain, or community of people sharing a common profession, interest, or characteristic. Often used as a suffix.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{芸能|げいのう}{界|かい}で{活躍|かつやく}している。
examples.english: She is active in the entertainment world.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}{界|かい}では{大|おお}きな{変化|へんか}があった。
examples.english: There was a big change in the political world.

examples.japanese: {学会|がっかい}は{学術|がくじゅつ}{界|かい}の{重要|じゅうよう}な{集|あつ}まりだ。
examples.english: Academic conferences are important gatherings in the scholarly world.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{芸能|げいのう}{界|かい} (entertainment industry)
・{政治|せいじ}{界|かい} (political world)
・{財|ざい}{界|かい} (financial world)
・{学|がっ}{界|かい} (academic world)
・スポーツ{界|かい} (sports world)
・{世界|せかい} (the world)

Note: {界|かい} is typically used as a suffix attached to a field or domain.
